scripts.build: tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit && EXPO_NO_BUNDLE_SPLITTING=1 expo export --platform all
scripts.test:browser: npm --prefix .. run build:contracts && npm --prefix .. run build -w @app/backend && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:behaviors: npm --prefix .. run build:contracts && npm --prefix .. run build -w @app/backend && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --grep canonical
